agent_boundary: Agent selects an intervention family and semantic structure; deterministic C++ estimates numeric values, replays history and enforces commit guards.

tools.name: get_theta
tools.description: Read the current global HSMM baseline configuration.

tools.name: get_anchors
tools.description: Read current anchors; returned ids are the only personalization keys.

tools.name: get_error_stats
tools.description: Aggregate labeled departure outcomes.

tools.name: get_leave_episode
tools.description: Read push and label rows for one episode.

tools.name: get_leave_window_samples
tools.description: Read bounded sparse location and walking samples around a push.

tools.name: get_leave_sensor_summary
tools.description: Read bounded Wi-Fi, cell, GPS, PDR, barometer and magnetic semantic summaries.

tools.name: get_episode_semantic_timeline
tools.description: Read a bounded aligned semantic timeline; missing remains distinct from observed zero.

tools.name: get_episode_dynamic_diagnostics
tools.description: Compute semantic event intervals, vertical recovery and cross-sensor lags.

tools.name: get_current_user_anchor_profile
tools.description: Read the committed anchor-specific evidence, duration and feature profile.

tools.name: get_personalization_history_summary
tools.description: Read outcome, primitive and duration facts grouped by anchor id without recommendations.

tools.name: get_context_template_catalog
tools.description: Read the only event, applicability and effect primitives allowed in templates.

tools.name: get_aborted_leave_candidates
tools.description: Read per-episode descent, ascent, closure, outside and support-event timing.

tools.name: propose_aborted_leave_interpretation
tools.description: Propose a FALSE_PUSH as ABORTED_LEAVE; C++ validates shared prefix, ascent, closure and no outside.

tools.name: diagnose_context_template
tools.description: Run read-only active-template sequence ablation.

tools.name: evaluate_negative_pattern_candidates
tools.description: Read-only bounded batch replay replacing only negative_pattern; frozen active context and strength, or negative-only LOW without a template. Does not stage or commit.

input_schema.candidates: required string: 1..8 pipe-separated patterns; each 1..6 comma-separated catalog events

output_schema.candidates: array of pattern, eligible, rejection and replay

tools.name: generate_context_template
tools.description: Validate one Agent-composed structure, estimate requested feature families and stage the best replay-safe candidate.

tools.name: get_context_template_trial
tools.description: Inspect the staged structure candidate and guard results.

tools.name: commit_context_template
tools.description: Commit only the C++-selected replay-safe structure candidate.

tools.name: discard_context_template
tools.description: Discard the staged structure candidate.

tools.name: get_active_context_template
tools.description: Read the committed executable context template.

tools.name: estimate_evidence_strength
tools.description: Fit selected anchor-specific channel strengths and stage a replay-checked candidate; numeric targets are not accepted.

tools.name: get_evidence_strength_trial
tools.description: Inspect the staged evidence-strength candidate.

tools.name: commit_evidence_strength_candidate
tools.description: Commit only a replay-safe anchor-specific evidence-strength candidate.

tools.name: discard_evidence_strength_candidate
tools.description: Discard the staged evidence-strength candidate.

tools.name: fit_duration_prior
tools.description: Robustly fit one anchor-specific HSMM state duration and stage a replay-checked candidate; numeric targets are not accepted.

tools.name: get_duration_prior_trial
tools.description: Inspect the staged duration candidate.

tools.name: commit_duration_prior_candidate
tools.description: Commit only a replay-safe anchor-specific duration candidate.

tools.name: discard_duration_prior_candidate
tools.description: Discard the staged duration candidate.

tools.name: submit_agent_analysis
tools.description: The only final audit entry. Persist Agent intervention choice separately from deterministic-tool outcome.

tools.name: request_anchor_reestimate
tools.description: Queue deterministic anchor re-inference.
